title: PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent: a self-improving agent for long-running coding work
friendlyTitle: Prime Agent helps AI keep working on long coding tasks
summary: Prime Agent is an MIT-licensed coding-agent platform built around persistent work, subagents, reusable skills and an RLM programming model. It was the strongest AI-related mover in today’s collected GitHub Trending data and currently shows about 8,300 stars.
friendlySummary: Prime Agent is an open-source coding helper with memory, smaller helper agents and reusable skills. It was the fastest-moving AI project in today’s GitHub collection.
whyItMatters: Developers can use it to experiment with long-running autonomous coding, persistent Python analysis, headless automation and provider-flexible workflows. Its architecture documentation is also useful for studying how an agent separates its daemon, workers, kernels and persistence.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Developers can try it for longer coding jobs or study how a modern coding agent is built. Test it in a safe project before giving it access to important code.
